Our veterans deserve a VA working as hard as they did.

We introduced the Accountable Leadership for Veterans Act to make sure it does. This bill strengthens accountability at the top of the VA, fills critical leadership roles faster, and makes sure the people overseeing veterans' health care and benefits are held directly accountable for the care veterans receive.

When veterans need care, every second counts. VA leadership must be able to act without bureaucratic slowdowns.
